title: Web Storage and cookies
description: Compare browser-local preference storage with server-controlled session cookies, including expiry, browser restrictions and credential-safety risks.
objectives: Explain localStorage and sessionStorage lifetime and origin boundaries
Explain HttpOnly, Secure and SameSite cookie attributes
Persist only a nonsensitive UI preference where storage is available
Handle blocked storage without losing basic page functionality
rubric: I explained the origin and lifetime differences of Web Storage.
I demonstrated a safe theme preference with a storage-blocked fallback.
I did not store credentials or claim the offline page provides server authentication.
